# Javier Perez Tobia

> Applied AI / machine-learning engineer and researcher based in Madrid, Spain. B.Sc. in Physics & Mathematics from the University of British Columbia (96.2% cumulative average). Currently Senior Data Scientist I at QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey.

This file is a plain-text summary of https://javierperez21.github.io for language models and other automated readers.

## Experience

- QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, Europe (Sep 2023 to present). Data Scientist I, then Data Scientist II (Nov 2024), then Senior Data Scientist I (Nov 2025). Owns end-to-end AI and analytics workstreams and leads data-science teams of 5+ across energy, banking and telecom.
  - AI transformation of energy trading: ML forecasting and Gurobi-based multi-asset optimisation, end-to-end orchestration and deployment, capability building across software teams.
  - Digital transformation of refining operations: digital twins, real-time ML models for crude-property prediction, optimisation modules.
  - ML-driven retail-bank deposit pricing: price-sensitivity and portfolio-allocation models, with proofs of concept showing P&L impact in under four weeks, then wave-based deployment.
  - Customer-value optimisation for telecoms across Latin America and Europe: ML targeting, LLM solutions for call-transcription analytics and knowledge retrieval, data-lake redesign, a company-wide optimisation engine.
- McKinsey & Company, Data Science Intern, Europe (Jun to Jul 2022): optimisation models for futures pricing and asset allocation.
- University of British Columbia, DAIS & IDSL labs, Machine Learning Researcher (May 2021 to Jul 2022): adversarial robustness, adaptive model predictive control, biomolecular ML, time series.
- UBC, Teaching Assistant, MATH 116 Calculus I (2020 to 2021).
- Omdena x UN World Food Programme, Data-labelling Team Manager (2019): crop classification from satellite imagery in Nepal.
